title: Counter-Selector Wave 19: cross-domain governance transfer and successor-capable custody

operation_signature: identify the authority boundary and the unilateral-interference risk
establish or protect a rule-bound independent process
make the process accountable beyond the immediate principal
coordinate institutions with competing interests without collapsing them into one command surface

domain_receipts.basis: The Attorney General resignation record preserves a specific independence design for the Special Prosecutor—authority, staff, public accountability, protection from countermand—and Richardson's refusal to destroy that design when ordered to remove its holder.

The presidential appointment, resignation, interagency, and successor records preserve work toward a stable legal framework that accommodated navigation, resources, science, environmental protection, and dispute settlement while limiting unilateral maritime claims.

The United Nations appointed Richardson as the Secretary-General's personal representative for an unprecedented sovereign-election verification mission; the official mission description records impartial observation, separate-but-coordinated UN/OAS monitoring, and a distributed communications-and-observer system.

new_support_assignments.ceiling: Three high-status appointments do not by themselves prove transfer. Support is bounded to the repeated rule-bound independent-authority operation visible in the cited artifacts; it does not establish technical breadth, low-support surplus, repeated personal model elasticity, or universal effectiveness.

new_support_assignments.basis: Richardson's outgoing Law of the Sea letter states that the near-complete convention's remaining tasks were in an experienced delegation's hands and offers continued assistance; the later official State record identifies successor leadership continuing Richardson's negotiating objectives and a draft retaining central navigation and anti-unilateral-claim provisions.
new_support_assignments.ceiling: This is bounded institutional transition custody, not a direct Richardson-to-Aldrich state-package receipt, recipient acknowledgment, complete finality, or proof that every component of the negotiation object survived unchanged.

countermodels: appointment breadth may reflect elite selection rather than transferable operation
institutional teams and successors may account for much of the observed output
the United States did not itself ratify the completed Law of the Sea Convention
the ONUVEN record does not isolate every operational decision to Richardson
resignation and successor continuity do not prove a direct person-to-person handoff

matched_controls.non_advance_reason: The acquired work remains within hemoglobinopathy, clinical care, and closely adjacent public-health implementation. Geographic and delivery breadth do not yet establish the same governing operation in a materially unrelated domain.

Movement from warning to redesign to verification is important repair continuation, but every acquired object remains inside the same shuttle solid-rocket-motor domain. Stage breadth is not cross-domain transfer.
